source_observation: TargetProfileProjection.from_mapping uses raw.get('schema', PROFILE_SCHEMA), so an absent target-profile schema is silently promoted to the canonical schema value.
hypothesis: Exact target-profile identity requires explicit schema evidence; absent schema must fail closed rather than mint an identity default.
counterhypothesis: Schema omission is intentionally backward-compatible and does not affect target identity because generation and digest are sufficient.
discriminator: Delete schema from an otherwise valid profile and require build_t1_userspace_plan to raise TargetUserspaceTwinError while all pre-existing tests remain unchanged.
recommended_repair: Canonical WP1202 owner should require raw.get('schema') == PROFILE_SCHEMA without a default and add this regression to the owned suite. Separately review whether profile_sha256 is cryptographically bound to the exact consumed profile projection before granting stronger target-identity claims.
